items.title: Union Pacific (UNP) Sees Truck-to-Rail Shift as Diesel Prices Surge

items.title: CSX (CSX) Plans Broad Rail Access Push If Transcontinental Merger Is Approved
items.summary: CSX (NasdaqGS:CSX) plans to seek broad access rights if the proposed Union Pacific and Norfolk Southern transcontinental merger proceeds. The freight carrier intends to request entry to pivotal corridors and shared terminals that could be controlled by the combined rail operator. CSX has raised competition concerns, arguing that the merger could reshape freight flows across the North American rail network.
